label: class_f_02_dragon_01
text: Hello, class! It is I, Hassel, yet again.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_02
text: In our previous class, we discussed what beauty\nis...which might have been a little boring for you.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_03
text: So today, I thought I would mix things up a little\nto pique your interest in art.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_04
text: Allow me to introduce our special guest![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_poke_01
text: Gib gibble.

label: class_f_02_dragon_05
text: This is Professor Gible, the assistant lecturer\nfor today.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_06
text: Now then, Professor Gible. If you would be so\nkind as to Terastallize for us...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_poke_02
text: Glaaam!

label: class_f_02_dragon_07
text: As some of you may already know, a Pokémon\ncan Terastallize if you use a Tera Orb.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_08
text: Normally, Professor Gible would be of the\nDragon type...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_09
text: But by Terastallizing, it’s succeeded in changing\nits type![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_10
text: So, class...what type do these lovely, glistening\nflowers above Professor Gible’s head represent?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_select_01
text: The Grass type

label: class_f_02_select_02
text: The Fire type

label: class_f_02_select_03
text: The Water type

label: class_f_02_dragon_answer_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Excellent, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\nFull marks\r\nfor you![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_11
text: These beautiful flowers blooming above\nProfessor Gible’s head show that it has now\r\nbecome a Grass type.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_12
text: The shape of the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Jewel[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] above a Pokémon’s\nhead depends on the Pokémon’s Tera Type.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_13
text: To summarize! If an opponent’s Pokémon\nTerastallizes during battle...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_14
text: observe a Pokémon’s Tera Jewel closely to see\nwhich type it has become![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_15
text: And choose effective moves accordingly![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_16
text: It is my sincere hope that today’s lecture will\nhelp you all achieve beautiful victories.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_17
text: The Terastal phenomenon is indeed a fascinating\nand deep subject to discuss.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_dragon_18
text: That is it for today, class! Thank you, Professor\nGible, for your help.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_02_poke_03
text: Glam-gib.
